# Project rules

- Keep the quiz self-contained in `index.html`; do not add a server or external dependencies.
- Preserve the existing quiz flow and mission-control visual style.
- Keep the interface responsive and accessible: semantic HTML, keyboard support, visible focus, and reduced-motion support.
- Preserve both `prefers-color-scheme` themes and use the existing CSS variables for colors.
- After UI changes, verify the experience in the integrated browser.
